title: ShowCakeYear
description: Shows the cake year on the item, applies texture variants for special year patterns, and supports per-year texture overrides through an in-game command.
body:
ShowCakeYear is a lightweight client-side QoL mod for Hypixel SkyBlock that makes New Year Cakes easier to identify at a glance, with an option to change cake textures to custom colors.

Automatic texture variants:

Midnight new year celebrations -> black cake texture

4 am new year celebrations -> blue cake texture

all others -> default texture

/cakes for help/tutorial

Includes legacy pink color for New Year Cakes
